title: Whitespace as a UI Component, Not a Leftover
description: The foundational UI/UX principle every other design decision builds on: treat space as a deliberate, systematic tool for grouping, hierarchy, and meaning — not whatever's left over after everything else is placed.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Whitespace as a UI Component, Not a Leftover.png

title: Padding and Margin Are Different Jobs, Not Interchangeable Values
description: Padding as internal breathing room vs. margin as separation, and the token-naming split that keeps the two from getting swapped.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Padding and Margin Are Different Jobs, Not Interchangeable Values.png

title: Color Contrast Is Math, Not Taste
description: The one part of color theory that isn't a matter of opinion: measurable contrast ratios, semantic color tokens, and the exact WCAG numbers a palette either passes or fails.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Color Contrast Is Math, Not Taste.png

title: A Color Palette Is a Token System, Not a Row of Swatches
description: Why HSL's lightness value lies about perceived brightness, how to build a perceptually even OKLCH tonal ramp, the primitive/semantic/component tiers that give each step a role, and how light and dark themes should remap aliases instead of duplicating the palette.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/A Color Palette Is a Token System, Not a Row of Swatches.png

title: Font Size Is a Formula, Not a Feeling
description: The math that replaces font-size guesswork: modular scale ratios, the line-height and measure numbers that actually govern readability, and the exact clamp() formula for type that resizes itself without breakpoints.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Font Size Is a Formula, Not a Feeling.png

title: Auto Layout Is a Constraint System, Not a Convenience Toggle
description: The mental model behind Figma's most misunderstood feature: how Fixed, Hug, and Fill actually resolve against each other, why nested frames break in predictable ways, and the exact property mapping developers need for CSS Flexbox handoff.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Auto Layout Is a Constraint System, Not a Convenience Toggle.png

title: Accessibility Is a Structural Decision, Not a Final Pass
description: How the accessibility tree actually gets built from markup, how a control's accessible name is computed, ARIA's real rules, focus management, keyboard patterns for custom widgets, and what automated testing quietly misses.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Accessibility Is a Structural Decision, Not a Final Pass.png

title: Design Tokens Are a Naming System, Not a Style Guide
description: The part of a design system that actually decides whether it survives a rebrand: primitive, semantic, and component token tiers, the aliasing chain between them, and the naming rules that keep tokens from drifting back into hardcoded values.
thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Design Tokens Are a Naming System, Not a Style Guide.png

title: Responsive Layout Is a Contract, Not a Breakpoint List

title: Motion Timing Is a Physics Model, Not a Preset

thumbnail: /thumbnail_image/Motion Timing Is a Physics Model, Not a Preset.png

title: Dark Mode Is a Second Palette, Not an Inverted Filter
description: Elevation through lightness instead of shadow, desaturating hues so they don't vibrate on black, and re-deriving contrast ratios from scratch.

title: Font Pairing Is a Hierarchy Decision, Not a Personality Match
description: Pairing by contrast and function, x-height matching, and why a superfamily solves more problems than a "creative" pairing.
